email_subject: Filling Maple Street's empty hygiene chairs
email_body:
Hi Dr. Patel,

Congrats on the Round Rock opening. A few reviews mention waiting weeks to rebook, which usually means chairs sit empty after late cancellations.

We built a model that flags likely no-shows from your booking history and auto-offers those slots to waitlisted patients. Practices your size typically recover 25-35% of lost hygiene visits.

Worth a 20-minute look at a working prototype?

[Your Name]
elevator_pitch: Every empty hygiene chair costs Maple Street about $180. We predict which appointments will no-show and backfill them automatically from your waitlist, using data you already have.
next_step_cta: Run a 4-week pilot at Round Rock measuring no-show rate.
ceo_pitch_title: Filling Maple Street's empty chairs with AI
why_we_reached_out: Congratulations on opening Round Rock in April. Reviews mention weeks-long waits to rebook, which usually means chairs sit empty after late cancellations, a gap that doubles with two clinics.
